name: codex
description: Installs Codex CLI and mounts ~/.codex and ~/.agents from the host so auth and sessions persist.

exclude.description: Comma-separated entry names to keep container-local instead of symlinking from the host: top-level entries of `~/.codex` and `~/.agents` (e.g. `config.toml,skills`). Also suppresses container->host adoption for the listed entries.
